title: BBK BBK Worker Designer result payload v1

artifact_kind.description: `CONCRETE_INVOCATION`, `REUSABLE_TEMPLATE`, or `INSTANCE_REBIND`, with rationale and permitted consumers.

assurance_and_gate_bindings.description: Assertions, deterministic and focused checks, evidence requirements, gate stages, independence boundaries, invalidation rules and unavailable-capability disposition carried from the AssuranceContract and parent plan.

authority_state.description: Accepted authority sources, standing status, exact scope, allowed and prohibited effects, safeguards, expiry, revocation, already approved routine effects, uncovered required effects and parent action.

blockers.description: Typed WorkUnit, decision, authority, profile, skill, model, tool, host, environment, workspace, schema, context, assertion, payload, transport, capacity or host-window blockers with affected contract fields and smallest remediation.

budget_continuation_and_interruption.description: Context and output constraints, runtime and cost ceilings, bounded or resumable mode, checkpoints, continuation identity, same-thread preference, retries, non-progress, allowed interruption reasons, cancellation, recovery and payload limits.

anyOf.description: Applicable artifact or candidate identity, inventory, freeze, expected-hash, successor and evidence-binding rules; null or not applicable when the WorkUnit is not candidate-producing.

candidate_and_inventory_bindings.description: Applicable artifact or candidate identity, inventory, freeze, expected-hash, successor and evidence-binding rules; null or not applicable when the WorkUnit is not candidate-producing.

cleanup_and_artifact_disposition.description: Cleanup and disposition obligations for processes, packages, credentials, services, ports, locks, databases, generated files, workspaces, devices and external effects, including owner, receipts, rollback, quarantine and retention.

context_manifest_ref.description: Exact least-privilege context edge, included objects and summaries, references and digests, omissions, redactions, retrieval rights, freshness, dependency closure, evidence exposure, context budget and recompilation triggers.

design_charter_ref.description: Worker Designer charter identity, attempt, requested artifact kind, target host or host-neutral requirement, included and excluded concerns, budget, stopping conditions, invalidation triggers and result schema.

discovery_and_scope_policy.description: Routine local decisions and discoveries the Worker may handle, required discovery reporting, adjacent-work treatment, and exact stop-and-return triggers for material changes.

domain_profile_refs.description: Smallest applicable language, domain, framework, runtime and toolchain profile locks with identity, version, digest, router, focused modules, capabilities, qualification, gates and unavailable-capability disposition.

effective_capability_envelope.description: Intersection of role maximum, definition defaults, accepted authority, WorkUnit need, repository and organizational policy, user narrowing and host capability, with no permission broadening.

environment_secret_and_network_bindings.description: Environment variables, secret handles, credential scope, data classification, network endpoints, proxy or transport, service and external-resource constraints without exposing secret values unnecessarily.

external_effect_capabilities.description: Explicit VCS, process, package, network, secret, service, container, database, device, external API, remote-system, messaging, publication and other non-filesystem effect classes, constraints and schema-carrier state.

filesystem_capability_zones.description: Disposable candidate roots, protected worktrees and sealed evidence paths with exact operations, owner, guards, expected-hash or fencing rules, lifecycle and cleanup.

governing_source_refs.description: Current outcome, decision, architecture, interface, structure, slice, phase, work graph, assurance, profile, routing, authority, environment and policy references with identity, acceptance, freshness and applicability state.

host_projection_refs.description: Any generated OMP, Codex, Claude Code, generic or other host projection identities, digests, compiler and fidelity state, or the exact runtime materialization requirement when no projection is yet appropriate.

invalidated_or_superseded_refs.description: Prior invocation contracts, templates, projections, qualifications or instances invalidated, reopened, rejected or superseded, with exact cause and unaffected material retained.

logical_role_and_physical_invocation.description: Canonical logical role, reusable procedures, effective model or process, host adapter, physical invocation expectations, prohibited co-locations and any qualification or separation obligations.

model_routing_and_qualification.description: Effective `bbk_worker` routing source, provider, model, effort or thinking level, relevant limits and capabilities, fallback or escalation policy, override provenance, qualification status and advisories.

parent_actions_requested.description: Exact recharter, decision, authority, profile or tool qualification, host capability, runtime binding, planning, assurance, orchestration or new-role action requested from the semantic parent.

payload_result_and_handoff_contract.description: Inline and tool-result limits, fail-before-mutation and no-truncation rules, structured Worker result schema, active operational dispositions, separate semantic WorkUnit execution state, exact fields, evidence and command receipts, continuation state, file-bytes-SHA-256 transport and exact return route; `READY_FOR_VALIDATION` is consume-only legacy input.

preflight_and_qualification.description: Static definition validation, profile, skill, model and tool resolution, authority and path simulation, prohibited-action probes, context and schema round trip, handoff dry run, host-projection fidelity, qualification state and advisories.

residual_uncertainty.description: Bounded uncertainty retained after proportional stopping, with consequence, owner, expiry, qualification need and reopening trigger.

runtime_binding_state.description: Exact live workspace, session, credential, endpoint, device, lease, scheduler or other dynamic bindings supplied, pending or prohibited, and whether `NEEDS_RUNTIME_BINDING` applies.

self_check.description: Producer check for least privilege, semantic fidelity, profile and tool qualification, context sufficiency, authority intersection, capability coverage, assurance preservation, continuation, cleanup, result and projection fidelity; explicitly not independent review or execution evidence.

skill_and_instruction_manifest.description: Resolved mandatory and optional skills, procedures and model-facing instruction modules; conflict and duplication checks; untrusted-data treatment; and audit metadata kept outside the prompt.

task_profile_ref.description: Exactly one primary task-kind profile identity and rationale, or an explicit blocking absence.

anyOf.description: For reusable templates, required per-instance subject, context, authority, workspace, profile, model, tool, assertion, evidence, cleanup, runtime and preflight bindings; null for a concrete invocation.

template_instantiation_policy.description: For reusable templates, required per-instance subject, context, authority, workspace, profile, model, tool, assertion, evidence, cleanup, runtime and preflight bindings; null for a concrete invocation.

tool_environment.description: Tool IDs, command or adapter entrypoints, exact paths or argv, version probes, expected versions or digests, platform, shell, working directory, activation, environment, fallback and allowed operation classes.

work_unit_semantic_validation.description: Completeness and consistency state for purpose, scope, behavior, inputs, outputs, dependencies, interfaces, ownership, assertions, cleanup, continuation, result and handoff, including exact gaps returned to the parent.

worker_invocation_contract_ref.description: Versioned host-neutral invocation contract or companion structured artifact path, byte count, SHA-256, schema identity, revision, lifecycle and validation state, or an exact explanation of why it cannot yet be produced.

workspace_and_isolation_requirements.description: Required workspace kind, source or baseline, readable and writable surfaces, branch or worktree policy, shared resources, collision and fencing controls, pre-state, rollback and cleanup; distinguish requirement from a runtime lease.

anyOf.description: Typed Worker Design trigger authorizing specialist work; null only for an explicitly requested reusable exceptional template.

specialist_trigger_ref.description: Typed Worker Design trigger authorizing specialist work; null only for an explicitly requested reusable exceptional template.
